import json,urllib.request,time
opener=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
def imds(path):
 with opener.open(urllib.request.Request('http://169.254.169.254'+path,headers={'Metadata':'true'}),timeout=20) as r:return json.load(r)
vm=imds('/metadata/instance/compute?api-version=2021-02-01');assert vm['name']=='ugrp-sim-azure4'
token=imds('/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https%3A%2F%2Fmanagement.azure.com%2F')['access_token']
url='https://management.azure.com'+vm['resourceId']+'/runCommands/vm4-identity-probe?api-version=2024-11-01'
body={'location':vm['location'],'properties':{'source':{'script':'printf VM4_IDENTITY_PROBE_OK'},'timeoutInSeconds':60,'asyncExecution':True}}
r=urllib.request.Request(url,data=json.dumps(body).encode(),method='PUT',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json'})
with opener.open(r,timeout=60) as response:print(json.dumps({'put_status':response.status}),flush=True)
for _ in range(24):
 r=urllib.request.Request(url+'&$expand=instanceView',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token})
 with opener.open(r,timeout=30) as response:data=json.load(response)
 view=data['properties'].get('instanceView',{})
 if view.get('executionState') in ('Succeeded','Failed'):
  print(json.dumps({'state':data['properties']['provisioningState'],'view':view}));break
 time.sleep(5)
else:raise RuntimeError('probe did not complete within 120 seconds')

from pathlib import Path

RG='UGRP-SIM-RG'

out=Path(__file__).parent
def az(*args):
    p=subprocess.run(['az',*args,'--subscription',SUB,'--only-show-errors','-o','json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if p.returncode: raise RuntimeError(p.stderr)
    return json.loads(p.stdout) if p.stdout.strip() else {}
def save(name,data):
    (out/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')

disk=az('disk','create','-g',RG,'-n','ugrp-sim-azure4-os','--source',BASE+'/providers/Microsoft.Compute/snapshots/ugrp-sim-azure3-source-20261012','--location','koreacentral','--size-gb','128','--sku','StandardSSD_LRS')

import json, sys, uuid, hashlib, datetime
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
from scripts.azure_api import Arm, BASE, SUB, ACCOUNT, VM_ID
a=Arm();api='?api-version=2022-04-01';compute='?api-version=2024-11-01';automation='?api-version=2024-10-23'
vm4=VM_ID+'4'
vm=a.request('GET',vm4+compute);principal=vm['identity']['principalId']
old=a.request('GET',VM_ID+compute)['identity']['principalId']
account=a.request('GET',ACCOUNT+automation);auto=account['identity']['principalId']
existing=a.request('GET',VM_ID+'/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments'+api)['value']
roles=[];assignments=[]
for row in existing:
 p=row['properties']
 if p['principalId']!=old or p['scope'].lower()!=VM_ID.lower():continue
 role=p['roleDefinitionId']; definition=a.request('GET',role+api)
 actions=definition['properties']['permissions'][0]['actions']
 allowed={'Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/read','Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/instanceView/read','Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/deallocate/action','Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/runCommands/read','Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/runCommands/write'}
 if not set(actions)<=allowed:continue
 roles.append({'id':role,'actions':actions})
 for who in ([principal,auto] if 'Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/runCommands/write' in actions else [principal]):
  name=uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_URL,vm4+who+role)
  result=a.request('PUT',vm4+f'/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/{name}'+api,{'properties':{'roleDefinitionId':role,'principalId':who,'principalType':'ServicePrincipal'}})
  assignments.append(result['properties'])
assert len(assignments)==3,assignments
runbook=a.request('GET',ACCOUNT+'/runbooks/Stop-UgrpVMs'+automation)
content=a.request('GET',ACCOUNT+'/runbooks/Stop-UgrpVMs/content'+automation)
assert '/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines?api-version=' in content
assert '$total -ge 150' in content and '2026-11-18T15:00:00Z' in content
schedules={name:a.request('GET',ACCOUNT+'/schedules/'+name+automation)['properties'] for name in ['daily-backup-kst','credit-expiry-kst','hourly-credit-check']}
assert all(p['isEnabled'] for p in schedules.values())
jobs=a.request('GET',ACCOUNT+'/jobSchedules'+automation)['value']
bindings=[]
for job in jobs:
 p=a.request('GET',job['id']+automation)['properties']
 if p.get('runbook',{}).get('name')=='Stop-UgrpVMs':bindings.append(p)
budget=a.request('GET',f'/subscriptions/{SUB}/providers/Microsoft.CostManagement/budgets/ugrp-credit-20261011?api-version=2025-03-01')['properties']
discovered=a.request('GET',f'/subscriptions/{SUB}/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines'+compute)['value']
assert vm4.lower() in [v['id'].lower() for v in discovered]
result={'checked_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'vm':vm4,'principal':principal,'automation_principal':auto,'roles':roles,'assignments':assignments,'runbook':{'state':runbook['properties']['state'],'sha256':hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest(),'discovery':'same subscription VM list query discovers VM4; no shutdown runbook invoked','vm4_discovered':True,'stop_usd':150,'expiry_utc':'2026-11-18T15:00:00Z'},'schedules':schedules,'bindings':bindings,'budget':budget}
Path('outputs/azure-vm4-setup/cloud-safety.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print('VM4-only assignments',len(assignments),'published',runbook['properties']['state'],'schedule bindings',len(bindings))

systemctl disable ugrp-auto-archive.timer ugrp-azure-recover.service ugrp-azure-guard.timer
systemctl stop 'home-ugrp-ugrp\x2dsim-arm.mount' || true
root=/home/ugrp/ugrp-sim
mkdir -p "$root/clone-excluded-vm1-20261012"
for item in runs leases lifecycle; do
  if [ ! -e "$root/clone-excluded-vm1-20261012/$item" ]; then
    mv "$root/$item" "$root/clone-excluded-vm1-20261012/$item"
    mkdir "$root/$item"
  fi
done
cat > "$root/clone-excluded-vm1-20261012/EXCLUDED.json" <<'EOF'
{"source_vm":"ugrp-sim-azure","snapshot":"ugrp-sim-azure3-source-20261012","status":"quarantined_clone_not_vm4_runs","archive_admission":"excluded","delete_authorized":false,"note":"Original VM1 and ARM evidence remain authoritative; cloned files retained pending hash audit."}
EOF
chown -R ugrp:ugrp "$root/runs" "$root/leases" "$root/lifecycle" "$root/clone-excluded-vm1-20261012"
hostnamectl set-hostname ugrp-sim-azure4
printf 'preserve_hostname: true\n' > /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/99-ugrp-vm4-hostname.cfg
rm -f /etc/machine-id /var/lib/dbus/machine-id
systemd-machine-id-setup
ln -s /etc/machine-id /var/lib/dbus/machine-id

runuser -u ugrp -- ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C ugrp-sim-azure4-archive -f /home/ugrp/.ssh/id_ed25519_arm_archive

rm -f /run/nologin
printf 'VM4_BOOTSTRAP_OK\n'
